description: This file contains serialization, deserialization, and deep copying implementations for various Tuple types in the Orleans serialization framework. It defines generic classes for serializing tuples with different arities (from 1 to 8 elements), along with corresponding deep copier classes to facilitate object copying within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: TupleCodec`1
classes.description: Serializer for a Tuple with one element, handling serialization and deserialization of Tuple<T> objects.

classes.name: TupleCopier`1
classes.description: Deep copier for Tuple<T>, supporting shallow and deep copy modes.

classes.name: TupleCodec`2
classes.description: Serializer for a Tuple with two elements, handling serialization and deserialization of Tuple<T1, T2> objects.

classes.name: TupleCodec`3
classes.description: Serializer for a Tuple with three elements, handling serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: TupleCopier`3
classes.description: Deep copier for Tuple<T1, T2, T3>.

classes.name: TupleCodec`4
classes.description: Serializer for a Tuple with four elements.

classes.name: TupleCopier`4
classes.description: Deep copier for Tuple<T1, T2, T3, T4>.

classes.name: TupleCodec`5
classes.description: Serializer for Tuple with five elements.

classes.name: TupleCopier`5
classes.description: Deep copier for Tuple<T1, T2, T3, T4, T5>.

classes.name: TupleCodec`6
classes.description: Serializer for Tuple with six elements.

classes.name: TupleCopier`6
classes.description: Deep copier for Tuple<T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6>.

classes.name: TupleCodec`7
classes.description: Serializer for Tuple with seven elements.

classes.name: TupleCopier`7
classes.description: Deep copier for Tuple<T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6, T7>.

classes.name: TupleCodec`8
classes.description: Serializer for Tuple with eight elements.

classes.name: TupleCopier`8
classes.description: Deep copier for Tuple<T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6, T7, T8>.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a tuple object into a wire format using the provided writer.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes data from the reader into a tuple object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input tuple, considering cyclic references and shallow copy modes.

methods.name: IsShallowCopyable
methods.description: Indicates whether the underlying element copiers are null, meaning the tuple can be shallow-copied.
